firstPathEvidence: The producer receipt stores only sticky failed Boolean; revFail and revPublish catch store no first-site/route/code/ordinal. The retained Java observer records no refusal and cannot identify a local producer failure site. No actual original callback route/status/rejection first-order receipt exists in this archive. Therefore first revFail cause is UNKNOWN; callback rejection is a concrete source-consistent candidate, not a proved runtime cause.

sourceFindings.fact: Selected callback wrapper forwards original once and returns its unchanged promise, but its rejection handler unconditionally calls revFail before done. It does not distinguish original application delivery rejection from observer corruption. done decrements actual pending and publishes the numeric receipt.

sourceFindings.fact: Original runtime explicitly catches and ignores uncertain consumed outcome-callback rejection and lifecycle-callback rejection. The original Promise still rejects to the wrapper observer, so a deliberately handled original callback failure can complete genuine stop/managed dispatch/busy false yet leave producer failed true. No malformed private observer notice or raw-SDK settlement is necessary for this sequence.

Managed dispatch/refresh wrapper separately marks original promise rejection as revFail. Original dispatch after genuine consumed context loss ordinarily returns its UNKNOWN outcome following caught callback and fulfilled stop; native entry and busy false alone do not prove whether the operation promise fulfilled. An actual original operation rejection remains unobserved as a first cause; do not conflate it with callback rejection.

Private numeric protocol ACK/schema/sequence handling, descriptor restoration, bounded private sample/root/file checks and observer bookkeeping each can call sticky revFail independently. Fourteen sent/acked rules out a missing final numeric ACK; it does not rule out prior sample-write, pin/guard or callback failures. RestoreRefusal0 rules out a retained restoration category, not every earlier revFail.
